summary: Barings Private Credit Corp filed an 8-K to report the sale of 862,318 unregistered shares for $17.3M under a continuous private offering, declared a monthly distribution of $0.175/share, and disclosed net asset value of $20.04/share. This constitutes ordinary operational and financing activity, not a special situation. The continuous offering and regular dividend are routine for a BDC, with no transformative change. No deal terms apply. Watch for continued monthly share issuance under the $4.5B program.
